entries.title: Proverbs 28:1
segments: The wicked flee [when] no man pursues; but the righteous are bold as a lion.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:2
segments: Because of the transgression of a land, many [are] its rulers; but [it is] prolonged by a man of discernment who knows [right].

entries.title: Proverbs 28:3
segments: A poor man who crushes the poor [is like] a sweeping rain which leaves no food.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:4
segments: Those who forsake the law praise the wicked; but those who keep the law plead against them.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:5
segments: Evil men do not understand judgment; but those who seek the LORD understand all [things].

entries.title: Proverbs 28:6
segments: Better [is] the poor who walks in his uprightness than he who [is] perverse [in his] ways, though he [is] rich.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:7
segments: Whoever keeps the law [is] a wise son, but a companion of gluttons shames his father.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:8
segments: He who increases his wealth by interest and unjust gain, [he shall] gather it for him who will pity the poor.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:9
segments: He who turns away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer [is] a hateful thing.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:10
segments: Whoever causes the righteous man to go astray in an evil way, he himself shall fall into his own pit; but the upright shall inherit good.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:11
segments: The rich man [is] wise in his own eyes; but the poor who has understanding searches him out.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:12
segments: When the righteous rejoice, [there is] great glory; but when the wicked rise, a man is hidden.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:13
segments: He who covers his sins shall not be blessed; but whoever confesses and leaves [them] shall have mercy.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:14
segments: Blessed [is] the man dreading [God], but he who hardens his heart shall fall into mischief.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:15
segments: [Like] a roaring lion and a ranging bear, [so is] a wicked ruler over the helpless people.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:16
segments: A ruler lacking understanding even adds oppressions; he who hates unjust gain shall prolong [his] days.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:17
segments: A man who is pressed down with the blood of a soul shall flee to the pit; do not let them uphold him.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:18
segments: Whoever walks uprightly shall be saved; but he who is perverse [in his] ways shall fall at once.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:19
segments: He who tills his land shall have plenty of bread, but he pursuing vanities shall have poverty enough.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:20
segments: A faithful man shall overflow with blessings, but he who makes haste to be rich shall not be innocent.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:21
segments: To have respect of persons [is] not good; yea, for a piece of bread a man will transgress.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:22
segments: He who hastens to be rich [has] an evil eye, and does not know that poverty will come upon him.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:23
segments: He who rebukes a man shall afterwards find [more] favor than he who flatters [with] the tongue.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:24
segments: Whoever robs his father or his mother and says, [It is] no sin he [shall be] a companion to a destroyer.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:25
segments: He who is of a proud heart stirs up fighting; but he who puts his trust in the LORD shall be made fat.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:26
segments: He who trusts in his own heart is a fool; but whoever walks wisely, he shall be delivered.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:27
segments: He who gives to the poor shall not lack, but he who hides his eyes shall have many a curse.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:28
segments: When the wicked rise, a man hides himself, but when they perish, the righteous increase.
